blocking.description: True when this lane cannot finish without the answer.

categories.description: Which kinds of member could answer it, such as product, design, architecture, data, security, compliance, operations, or business. A planning lane's question goes straight to the person, so it must name at least one.

options.description: What you would choose between, when you know.

recommendation.description: The option you would choose. When you give options, it must be one of them, written the same way.

recommendation_rationale.description: Why that option is the one to choose. A person who accepts the recommendation records this as the reason.

text.description: The question, as a person would read it.

title.description: The question in a few words, on one line, which a list shows in place of the text.

tradeoffs.description: What choosing each option gives up, keyed by the option, written the same way as in options.

unblocks.description: What the answer lets go on, such as the work it unblocks.
